items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: He said, “I’m a personal friend of Jacob” — I don’t remember his name, the President of the New York Local.

ctx.x: Anyway well I’ll go ahead with it. I said, “Artie, I’ve been here three months, you know, starving. And I don’t want to lose the three months time.” He said, “I’m a personal friend of Jacob” — I don’t remember his name, the President of the New York Local. He said, “I’ll see that your time goes on.
Because if you left New York, then you’d lose your three months? Is that the idea?
